title: Lucid And Uber Will Bring Robotaxis To Houston Next
source_used: Stocktwits (background on the same partnership); InsideEVs original blocked (HTTP 403)
key_facts: InsideEVs headline: Houston is the next city for the Lucid and Uber robotaxi service (article text not readable here).
Background from Stocktwits: the Lucid, Nuro and Uber robotaxi deal was announced in July 2025; Lucid supplies the Gravity electric SUV, Nuro the self-driving system, Uber owns and runs the fleet.
The partners aim to deploy at least 35,000 Lucid vehicles over coming years, with the first commercial service in the San Francisco Bay Area in late 2026 and Houston in mid-2027, per Stocktwits.
quote_evidence: The companies aim to deploy at least 35,000 Lucid vehicles as robotaxis over the coming years, with the first commercial service expected to launch in the San Francisco Bay Area in late 2026, followed by Houston in mid-2027.
why_it_matters_hint: Uber's robotaxi plans spread to a second Texas city already served by Tesla and Waymo.
notes: InsideEVs returned 403 twice. No other outlet carried the Houston story in the window; the Stocktwits LCID article (also 3 Oct in Google News) describes the same partnership and names Houston as the second city, but its own date references are unclear. Treat as headline only for the InsideEVs specifics.
